title: Public Alert No. 041/2025 – Recall of Indomie Brand Noodles (Vegetable Flavour Product) due to the Presence of Undeclared Allergens (Milk and Eggs)
summary: NAFDAC relays a French (Rappel Conso) recall of Indomie Vegetable Flavour noodles due to undeclared milk and egg allergens. All lots, BB date 06/02/2026. Risk of entry into Nigeria is low due to the noodle import ban, but surveillance and mop-up have begun.
